name: World Piece & Peace
original_name: ワールドピース&ピース
source: This is a an age of war between human and witches. After learning of the plans of invasion of the human world by the ruler of the witch kingdom Burharista, Tress leaves on a quest to save her friend Leeds. As the world colllapses and all actors make their move, the banished and repentants will finally raise again.
translation: 这是一个人类与女巫战争的时代。在得知女巫王国布尔哈里斯塔的统治者入侵人类世界的计划后，特蕾斯出发去拯救她的朋友利兹。当世界崩塌、众演员纷纷出手时，流放者和悔改者终于会重新站起来。
